verdict.rationale: PayPal's merchant marketing docs explicitly describe a no-code Payment Link feature: 'Swiftly create a Payment Link to share on your website, via email, on social media, or through text. No coding skills required,' positioned within PayPal Open's accept-payments dashboard offering (also supporting cards, wallets, Pay in 4). This directly matches the founder story of creating a shareable link with no code from the dashboard to start selling immediately. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on walkthrough confirming the exact dashboard flow or time-to-first-sale.
